content: iOS Safari auto-zooms the viewport when a focused input has a computed font-size below 16px. The threshold is the rendered size after scaling and inheritance — 16px or above prevents zoom. Best fix: set font-size: 16px (or 1rem when body is 16px at mobile breakpoint) on input[type=text] inside a @media (max-width: 767px) or @media (pointer: coarse) block. This is consistent across iOS Safari versions (9+). Sources: CSS-Tricks, Defensive CSS, multiple authoritative how-to references.
